name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

angles.text: As a druid from Zephras, you commune with the windborne cat spirit to master your feline form. The rite follows your heritage rather than Azeroth's traditional path.
As a Skyborne, you are called shen'dorei. The spirits of your homeland, Zephras, guide your druidic path.

aliases: who is the windborne cat spirit
faq.answer: The windborne cat spirit appears as the Avatar of Saeyleenan, from distant Zephras. It has come to Moonglade to mentor and test young shen'dorei druids seeking its feline shape.
faq.q: Who is the Great Windborne Cat Spirit?

aliases: where to find cat spirit moonglade
faq.answer: The Avatar of Saeyleenan appears in southern Moonglade, just south of the twin bridges.
faq.q: Where can the Avatar of Saeyleenan be found?

aliases: why does cat form look different
faq.answer: Shen'dorei druids come from Zephras, so their feline shape reflects the windborne spirits of their homeland rather than Azeroth's native big cats. The spirit oversees their trial to ensure they embody its essence.
faq.q: Why do Zephras druids commune with a different cat spirit?

aliases: what trial does the cat spirit give
how to get windborne cat form
faq.answer: The Avatar of Saeyleenan has the initiate undertake the trial of Azeroth's Great Cat Spirit. The Avatar supervises and confirms that the druid understands the windborne spirit's unique nature.
faq.q: What does the trial of the windborne cat entail?

faq.answer: The Avatar of Saeyleenan calls the initiate shen'dorei, marking their origin in Zephras and distinguishing their heritage and spiritual practices from Azeroth's native peoples.
Zephras is the distant homeland of the shen'dorei. Its native flora, fauna, and spirits differ from Azeroth's, giving rise to unique shapeshifting forms among its druids.

sections.body: South of Moonglade's twin bridges, a spirit from distant Zephras has appeared in the sacred sanctuary. Calling itself the Avatar of Saeyleenan, this windborne cat spirit has crossed into Azeroth to guide young shen'dorei druids ready to unlock their feline form.
sections.title: A Visitor from Zephras

sections.body: Druids seek wisdom in the feline form, but those from Zephras follow a different tradition from Azeroth's native peoples. The shen'dorei embody the windborne predator of their homeland instead of an Azerothian wildcat. So Saeyleenan oversees their trial in Moonglade, to teach them the spirit's nature.
sections.title: The Nature of the Windborne Form

summary: In Moonglade, the Avatar of Saeyleenan guides young shen'dorei druids through a spiritual trial. The spirit comes from Zephras and helps them embody the windborne feline form of their homeland.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
